execution_policy.note: Execution budget and reusable witness grouping only. Does not modify gate thresholds/statuses or waive verified P0 defects. New budget must follow evidence-based checkpoint review.
execution_policy.tranche_definition: Initial discovery-and-repair tranche only, not a forecast to complete all QA gates or unimplemented product features.
execution_policy.measurement: Productive agent hours linked to PR/witness/completed journey; report queue and waiting costs separately.
execution_policy.priority_rule: Confirmed defect/data integrity, then blocked player journey/missing implementation, then low-cost independent oracle, then breadth, then speculation.
execution_policy.qa_vs_product: QA-09 depends on unfinished five-destination Modern root implementation; keep product work separately estimated and owned.
execution_policy.review_state_caveat: PR states recorded at planning review; refresh before work. No listed PR qualifies as release-accepted solely by merging.
execution_policy.campaign_interpretation: Four integrated journeys A-D, plus targeted storage fault cuts overlaying B/D; original five categories retained for historical continuity.
execution_policy.candidate_rule: Never treat prior SHA as an exact newer candidate acceptance; rerun relevant shared smoke and affected gates; record actual ZIP hash.
execution_policy.scope_controls: USA primary 45; PAL/prototype 90 comparative; Original/Upscaled versus Remastered exposure and public ROM/legal decision handled explicitly at release level.
